authority_notes: Original id/name/action/default_enabled remain unchanged. All60 entries were reviewed; F14 remains disabled.
Manifested hostiles pursue the player. Ordinary encounters use1–2 independent enemies; later crowds remain explicit authored cases.
Correct real responses weaken the existing ability, armor or targeting behavior and never auto-clear the hostile manifestation.
T10 phase cell damage equals ordinary cell damage. Extra reward comes from billing committed phase lines once despite existing deadlines, then refreshing deadlines; no teleport damage multiplier.
A phase audit is not a physical path: ordinary floor traps, appliance contact, residence damage and airborne legality still require real geometry.

Electricity searches the full live connected component; ordinary positive electric damage adds1 charge, native authored+2 replaces rather than duplicates that generic+1. No total wave feedback cap or charge-storage cap. Actual deaths remove nodes before the next wave.
Paper interception is at most1s per target with a6s shared target interval; new dolls or towers cannot extend it. Local safety windows are intended.
Susceptible is nonstacking threshold minus1: heat7/frost3/curse3/electric4. Persistent poison has no burst threshold. Actual immunity and legal target checks still apply.
Trap recommendations mean stock bought and deployed before opening; business cannot replenish, redeploy, repair or upgrade traps.
Favorable/conditional/weak are specialization judgments, not universal DPS rankings. No new summoning, splitting or mirror ability is assigned just to justify crowd towers.

No existing catalogue monster is assumed to summon or split merely to justify a crowd specialization.
Low-air F13/F50 are not ground; freeze never grants ground contact.
F15 true phase pays all valid audit cells between its committed endpoints; F54 multiple parts remain one pool.

The proposed TD05 weekly economy and complete static tree review are design calculations; no seven-night gameplay or mobile client performance is claimed.
Ordinary pursuit reference bands do not override F46 mandatory dwell, F10/F54 anchored bodies, legitimate corner losses or successful slowdown/control.
